Class RecurringPaymentConfigurationBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.commercetools.api.models.cart.RecurringPaymentConfigurationBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Builder<RecurringPaymentConfiguration>
public class RecurringPaymentConfigurationBuilder extends Object implements Builder<RecurringPaymentConfiguration>
RecurringPaymentConfigurationBuilder
Example to create an instance using the builder pattern 

     RecurringPaymentConfiguration recurringPaymentConfiguration = RecurringPaymentConfiguration.builder()
             .paymentStrategy(PaymentStrategy.CHECKOUT)
             .plusPaymentAllocations(paymentAllocationsBuilder -> paymentAllocationsBuilder)
             .build()
